confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and dorm anchors are more reliable than hotel anchors, which vary with neighbourhood, season, and taxes. Ecuador uses the US dollar, so prices are quoted in USD directly. FX: the 0.6955 value was taken from search-result summaries of the RBA homepage and was not verified by opening the page. The RBA's own exchange-rates page returned older cached data in an earlier search.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is other mid-sized Andean and Latin American capitals with high-altitude tourism, such as Bogota, Lima, and Cusco, adjusted for Quito's USD pricing, its Old Town and La Mariscal hostel and hotel market, and July being the dry season with steady visitor demand.
